name: Moth Bean Usal
ingredients: ½ tsp each mustard seeds and cumin seeds
1 tsp goda masala or garam masala
¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp chilli powder
1 tsp tamarind pulp or lemon juice
steps: Heat the oil and crackle the mustard and cumin. Add the onion, ginger and garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato and spices and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the sprouts and 1 cup water, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
Stir in the tamarind and salt; simmer 3 minutes.
note: A Maharashtrian sprout curry and the base for misal. Sprouting raises vitamin content and aids digestion.
